fixes.name: UEVR
fixes.pros: Full VR immersion with 6DOF headtracking. On SR displays, XRGameBridge provides native SR Weave output with LeiaID camera headtracking.
fixes.cons: DX12 — some UEVR features limited vs DX11 titles. High GPU requirement.
fixes.notes: Unreal Engine 5 — use latest UEVR build. Community profile recommended from UEVR Discord. For VR headsets: UEVR outputs natively. For SBS/TAB/frame sequential: VRto3D or WibbleWobbleVR handle conversion automatically. For SR displays (SpatialLabs, Dimenco): set XRGameBridge as your active OpenXR runtime before launching — this gives native SR Weave output with LeiaID headtracking, which is better than the VRto3D+3DGameBridge path.
